W01.title: Password links: anti-enumeration, single use, replacement, expiry, address matching

steps.name: members and the advisor set passwords from emailed links and sign in
a known and an unknown address get the same status and message; the unknown one gets no email
an inactive user's address receives no email
a newer link replaces the older one; the older one sets nothing
a used link changes nothing
an expired link changes nothing
an unknown link answers 404; sign-in matches the address ignoring case and spaces

W02.title: Sessions: refusals, rotation, sign-out, cookie attributes, safe next= redirects

steps.name: a wrong password, an unknown address and an inactive user are refused alike, with no session
signing in starts a new session identifier; one held before never becomes signed in
signing out ends the session on the server
a visitor is sent to /signin with next=, and lands on the page after signing in
next= never leaves the site (//host, /\host, scheme:host, full URLs)

W03.title: Household isolation: pages, exports and form ids of other households

steps.name: the advisor sees the households listed for them, and gets 403 on the third
a member gets 403 for another household's pages, exports and accounts
ids of another household in a member's forms are refused and change nothing

W04.title: The advisor's read-only views: same figures as members, no write controls, every write refused

no page offers the advisor a form or button for a change

W05.title: Roles: a read-only viewer, a member who cannot lock, a preparer who reads and locks only, an inactive preparer

a statement for another account number is rejected as a whole-file problem (line 0)
